depiction_rules.notes: Named serpent of D054 stanza 3. Multiple serpent hoods are intentional only when continuous with one coherent body; do not render humanoid limbs.

visual_bible.form: One large dark river serpent with a clearly connected body and a cluster of distinct raised hoods
visual_bible.color: Deep muted indigo, charcoal, and restrained poison green accents; matte painted fields
visual_bible.expression: Proud and defensive, not monstrous or grotesque
visual_bible.anatomy: One continuous serpentine body; hood shapes emerge from one neck region; no human arms or legs
visual_bible.continuity_markers: Same serpent identity in the river refuge and Garuda pursuit; scale stays secondary to the divine and sage figures

never: no photorealism, gloss, gore, or cinematic poison effects
